mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits metabolism of tamoxifen and increases serotonergic activity, while tamoxifen has weak SERT inhibition properties, creating potential for serotonin syndrome and altered tamoxifen pharmacokinetics.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use alternative antidepressant; monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, rigidity) and tamoxifen toxicity.
